notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK witness for the IEEE 1516.1-2025 §12.13.5 TLS 1.3 over TCP/IP transport requirement. The scenario uses only the official RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies a tls:// RTI Address and provider-specific trust settings; the case connects and completes List Federation Executions with its report callback. It verifies the externally observable TLS transport route, not certificate-policy details or provider-wide conformance.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador::connect using an RtiConfiguration RTI Address with the tls:// scheme, followed by List Federation Executions and its report callback
